HediffDef.label: Essence Realm
HediffDef.description: The current essence realm. Essence realms grant progressive increasess in max qi and passive qi gathering, along with the improved bodily functions like the previous body realms.

li.label: Qi Refinement
li.extraTooltip: A circulatory system for Qi flow for the body along with its central storage (dantian) is established. Grants 10 base qi recovery amount, 1 base qi recovery speed and 2x max qi.

li.label: Core Shaping
li.extraTooltip: A spiritual foundation (spirit sea) is made, shaping the Golden Core for later creation. Grants 100 base qi recovery amount, 1.5 base qi recovery speed and 10x max qi.

li.label: Golden Core
li.extraTooltip: Qi in the body is concentrated into one point, creating a Golden Core. Grants 1200 base qi recovery amount, 2.7 base qi recovery speed and 100x max qi.

li.label: Nascent Soul
li.extraTooltip: A Nascent Soul is birthed from the cultivators spirit sea (spirit foundation). Grants 7000 base qi recovery amount, 3 base qi recovery speed and 500x max qi.

li.label: Soul Transformation
li.extraTooltip: A Nascent Soul is transformed, becoming more corporeal. Grants 12000 base qi recovery amount, 4 base qi recovery speed and 1000x max qi.

li.label: Pseudo-Immortal
li.extraTooltip: This being has achieved Pseudo-Immortality. They cannot grow older than the biological age of 21 years and have a greatly increased natural healing factor and will periodically heal thier worst health conditions including that which would otherwise be incurable, regrowing entirely new limbs or organs if needed. Heals every hour. Grants 24000 base qi recovery amount, 5 base qi recovery speed and 10000x max qi.

li.label: Profound Immortal
li.extraTooltip: This being is a Profound Immortal. They cannot grow older than the biological age of 21 years and have a greatly increased natural healing factor and will periodically heal thier worst health conditions including that which would otherwise be incurable, regrowing entirely new limbs or organs if needed. Heals every minute. Grants 77000 base qi recovery amount, 7 base qi recovery speed and 120000x max qi.
